_doc: CI check manifest read by scripts/ci_verdict.py. Each suite lists required and optional check ids (a trailing * is a prefix wildcard that must match at least one result). A required check passes only on PASS; FAIL, FLAKY, SKIPPED or a missing result fail the job, BLOCKED blocks it. Quarantine entries need all of id, suite, reason, owner, tracking, remove_when, expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 30 days ahead); they only cover measured FAIL/FLAKY results, and an expired entry makes the manifest invalid.

tier-a.description: Tier A: JVM suites, debug build and harness gates on every push.

voice.description: Voice checks on the emulator against the Gemini live harness (free tier, not deterministic). devrows: is the scenarios-device.json runner.

device.description: Device rows on the emulator without a voice model session (scripts/github_device_checks.sh).

navpiece.description: Navigation demo pieces (scripts/github_nav_demo.sh): every recorded navpiece: check is required except the video.

quarantine.reason: Cantonese home request scored 0/1 on Gemini; whether an ambiguous Cantonese request should ask back is an open owner decision
quarantine.remove_when: owner decides the expected behaviour and the scenario passes 1/1
